tasks.name: 创建笔记数据库模型
创建笔记API路由
创建笔记前端页面
实现笔记搜索功能

T1.implementation_approach: Design a database model with fields like title, content, timestamp, and tags using an ORM such as SQLAlchemy or Django ORM.
T1.notes: Ensure proper indexing for fields that will be used in search or filtering.

T2.implementation_approach: Create API routes using a framework like Flask or FastAPI to handle CRUD operations for notes.
T2.notes: Implement input validation and error handling for API endpoints.

T3.implementation_approach: Develop a frontend page using a framework like React or Vue.js to display, create, edit, and delete notes.
T3.notes: Use API integration to fetch and update data dynamically.

T4.implementation_approach: Implement a search function on the backend using query filters or full-text search, and integrate it with the frontend.
T4.notes: Optimize search performance and consider using libraries like Elasticsearch for advanced functionality.

file_structure.purpose: Define the Note database model with fields for id, title, content, created_at, and updated_at.
Implement CRUD API routes for managing notes, including creating, reading, updating, and deleting notes.
Set up the Flask application factory and initialize the database and routes.
Entry point for the Flask application, running the app and connecting to the database.
Create the frontend page for managing notes, including a form for creating notes, a list for displaying notes, and buttons for editing and deleting notes.
Provide styling for the notes management frontend page.
Extend the notes API routes to include a search functionality for finding notes by title or content keywords.
Add a search input box and results display area to the notes management frontend page.
